title: Hiring queue 1:1 prep — March cadence
body:
Purpose: quick prep notes for my 1:1 with Sam (Eng VP) — sync on open reqs, reprioritize backlog, and get alignment on interview loop changes.

Context: Sam asked for headcount reprioritization after Q1 usage trends (obs: more demand for inference infra eng/time-to-ship). Budget freeze conversation flagged by finance — we need to justify any hires outside critical path.

Meeting agenda (15–20m):
- 2m: quick status snapshot (open reqs + top blockers)
- 5m: propose 2 priority moves (infra SRE + quantization infra eng) + rationale
- 5m: interview loop changes proposal (shorter loop for IC3, add rubric + 30-min culture check)
- 3m: decisions and immediate next steps (who owns outreach, timeline)

Snapshot (candidates & reqs) — latest pull from ATS on 2026-03-04:
- Req: Sr Infra Engineer (REQ-187) — 4 active candidates (2 take-home code, 1 onsites scheduled, 1 screening)
- Req: Model Quantization Engineer (REQ-210) — 3 active (2 phone screens, candidate A moved to onsites)
- Req: Backend IC3 (REQ-199) — 6 in funnel but low quality, conversion ~8%
- Req: Data Platform Manager (REQ-172) — paused (budget review)

Notes on ask to Sam:
- Request: approval to move 1 headcount from Data Platform (paused) to Sr Infra (REQ-187) for Q2 immediate hire. Rationale: Infra has production SLO gaps leading to throttled hosted API demos for two enterprise trials. Quantified impact: projected ~15% latency reduction with hire + batching work, improves two inbound pipeline deals.
- Backup plan: if Sam cannot reallocate, ask for 90-day extension to keep req open and reuse contractor budget for priority projects (cost tradeoff: contractor cost ~1.6x hourly, but faster start).

Interview loop proposals (reduce cycle time):
- Current pain: scheduling 4-round onsites + lengthy debriefs -> offer velocity slow (~28 days avg).
- Proposal: for IC3/IC4 backend roles: move to 3 rounds (screen + combined system design + pair coding (90min) + 1x culture/role-fit 30m). Combine debrief into template; allow hiring mgr to sign-off for strong candidates.
- For senior roles (Sr Infra, Quantization Eng): keep deeper loop but shorten panel size (max 4 interviewers) and mandate pre-read scorecard.

Debrief rubric changes (draft):
- Add explicit prompt-level example expectations for pair coding (what constitutes pass/fail), include perf/scale scenario for infra roles.
- Introduce a single "risk score" field (0–3) to capture operational risk if hire is delayed.

Open questions for Sam:
1) Are we comfortable reassigning Data Platform headcount to Infra now or prefer contractor route?
2) If we shorten loops, can Eng leads commit to faster feedback (24–48h)?
3) Any constraints from legal/comp on expedited offers for enterprise trial hires?

Quick suggested script for the ask: "We can get REQ-187 to final offer within 21 days if we reduce onsite stages and reassign one headcount from Data Platform; that would unlock two enterprise POCs. If budget reallocation isn't possible, contractor for 90 days is our fallback. Which do you prefer?"

Action items to confirm before end of week (owner / ETA):
- Prepare cost tradeoffs (perm vs contractor) & updated timeline (Miriam) / 2026-03-10
- Draft revised interview scorecard + pair-coding examples (Priya) / 2026-03-11
- Contact hiring managers to flag proposed loop change and request feedback (Jordan) / 2026-03-10
- If Sam approves reallocation, open internal change request + notify finance (Miriam) / within 48h of approval

Notes-to-self / talking points:
- Emphasize business outcomes (enterprise trial impact) over abstract headcount numbers.
- Have numbers ready on cost-per-day for delayed hire (revenue or ops impact).
- If pushback on reallocating headcount, push contractor as contingency but note ramp risk.

Post-1:1 follow-up template (to send after meeting):
- TL;DR decision summary
- Action owner table (who, what, due date)
- Links to updated reqs, cost sheet, and new scorecards

Quick table (copy into email if needed):
Candidate pipeline CSV:
name,role,stage,interviewer,notes
Candidate A,Sr Infra,onsite,Sam scheduled 03/15,take-home good
Candidate B,Model Quant,phone,Priya,needs stronger systems experience
Candidate C,Backend IC3,screening,Jordan,low conversion

Misc references to include in follow-up:
- Confluence headcount plan (linked above)
- JIRA-RECR-3421 (req reprioritization ticket)
- Draft PR for scorecard (github.com/redwood-inference/recruiting/pull/58)

End of notes. Will refine after 1:1 and move to shared drive if Sam asks to make it a working doc.
